name: annotation-mode
description: Add and maintain a floating, element-anchored annotation mode for standalone HTML prototypes.

interface.shortDescription: Annotate HTML prototypes with stable, persistent markers.
interface.longDescription: Adds a floating controller, gated annotation mode, stable visible-element anchors, localStorage persistence, CRUD actions, and responsive marker placement.
interface.defaultPrompt: Add or review floating annotation mode in this HTML prototype.
